title: Ads storm don’t let me try the app
body: You guys have too much of ads in the app! A storm of ads doesn’t even let me to understand how to use the app before buying pro plan! First time I launched the app I have seen three ads before getting to main screen (OMG). Then after creating my first habit and being told to make it done, the fourth ad of pro plan just LOCKED THE APP, there was no way to close this ad or refuse it! The only way to keep testing your app was to restart it. And then I see a new very long advertisement every few times I touch the screen… As I got your offer, there is no way to buy the app once and forever, there is only a pro plan subscription. The subscription is very expensive. And the app looks like worth paying this price, but before such a spent I need to test it. To test it very well. And your storm of ads don’t let me. It stands between me and my decision to buy your pro plan! And don’t tell me “start a 7-day trial”! We both know that it’s just a trap for ones who forget to cancel it on the 7th day. You know better, but I think that you need to give people more options to use your app for free before buying pro plan. At this time the app is just impossible to use for free even to test-drive it.

title: Autosubscribes you and can’t cancel.
body:
Very lame move. You can’t unsubscribe from within the app itself and it doesn’t warn you clearly enough that starting the trail initiates a paid subscription.

This is a scam.
Most people don’t know how to turn off their subscription from the settings or even realize one has started for a very hefty sum.

I hope this app gets pulled off the app store quickly for very shady practices.
